text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Brian, happy birthday! Hey, so what<n>kinda present
do you want?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, so there's nothing you want<n>right now? Okay
then, we'll meet at<n>the station tomorrow, ten
o'clock. We<n>can go shopping for your present
together. ♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: You don't get to make plans for me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh, mind if I tag along then? I'll treat<n>ya to lunch.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, not you too, Ama... If you two<n>wanna hang out,
just go by yours—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
We could grab lunch at that new<n>steak place! From
what I hear, the<n>way they cook the meat, it just
gets<n>juicier and juicier with each bite.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you looked like you really wanted<n>to eat that
steak just now! ☆ That<n>settles tomorrow's plans,
then. You<n>copy?
